audit.why: Both layers already read Ahri on all seven rows and that matches the packet chart and a 50.7% win rate held up by Charm answering every Shunpo entry. No chart edit needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes never name Katarina's actual spike, which is Voracity: any takedown she has damaged refunds her cooldowns, so her power comes from the first kill, not an item.
audit.why: Riot text: "Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced."
audit.corrected: Reframed enemyWin and breakdown.feeding around Voracity resets rather than a generic item curve.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction — Death Lotus is a channel, and Charm cancels a channel — is hinted at but never stated, and the range maths that makes it safe is missing entirely.
audit.why: Death Lotus is a 550-range channel; Ahri's Charm is 975 range on a 12s cooldown. She must stand inside 550 to deal the damage, you can cancel it from 975, i.e. from outside her ultimate's reach. Shunpo is 725 range and "blinks to the target, striking it if its an enemy, or striking the nearest enemy otherwise" — it also takes daggers and minions, so the approach angle is not always through her.
audit.corrected: Stated the channel cancel with both ranges, and warned that Shunpo can come off a dagger or minion behind you.

audit.why: Shunpo is 12/11/10/9/8s and Death Lotus 75/60/45s — both are punishable windows, and Voracity refunds them on any takedown she touched.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, loading and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Death Lotus applies Grievous Wounds and nothing on the page says so.
audit.why: Enemy kit flags antiHeal on R; Ahri's whole sustain is Essence Theft's minion and takedown heal, which is cut once the ult lands.
audit.corrected: Added to the content late paragraph.

audit.why: The grounding flag on Bouncing Blade and the knockup flag on Preparation are tooltip-parse misfires — Riot's descriptions say only that the dagger bounces and ricochets to the ground, and that she tosses a dagger into the air above herself. Neither grounds nor displaces.
audit.corrected: Nothing written; noted so a later pass does not repeat the check.

edits.before: Your item spikes and Zhonya's give you the tools to survive any reset-chain all-in she manages to find on you, while your own burst and Charm setup let you punish her every time she dashes into a fight, so the matchup stays firmly in your favor into the late game.
